analysis.session_summary: GBP led the day at +0.179%, closing at its best, while AUD lagged at -0.166%. USD saw a normal retail-sales beat (+0.081% impulse) but gave back 100% to close -0.08%, and DXY fell 0.145%. JPY spiked +0.34% intraday before surrendering 79%, leaving USD/JPY down 26.1 pips. Late bank/NSA network headlines and a VIX rise of 3.277 points to 22.064 kept risk conditions fragile.
